analysis.title: NVIDIA Corp (NVDA.O): Nvidia Without Jensen? Lowering Target Price Again
key_insights: Citi cuts its NVDA target price to $225 from $285, a 20% discount to the prior 19x P/E, citing increased uncertainty. The Buy rating is kept.

Trigger: Bloomberg (11/11/26) reported that Nvidia's board is discussing the future of CEO Jensen Huang after allegations that he is under investigation over a relationship with an Nvidia executive. This follows scrutiny of a prior reported relationship involving a suspected Chinese intelligence asset.

Citi says a forced exit by Huang would end an era. He led Nvidia to dominance in AI infrastructure, and a leadership transition creates an overhang given his role in strategy, product vision, customer relationships and investor confidence.
Citi believes CFO Colette Kress could serve as interim CEO while the board evaluates external candidates.

Buy is kept because the stock trades at ~11x P/E, in line with its prior trough. Implied return to the $225 target is 29.5% (30.1% total with a 0.6% dividend yield) from the $173.73 close on 11 Nov 2026.
Citi's EPS estimates are unchanged: FY27E core EPS $9.26, FY28E $15.17, FY29E $19.98. FY27E and FY28E sit below consensus (First Call FY27 $9.30, FY28 $15.84, FY29 $20.99).
The new $225 target is based on ~15x P/E on C27E earnings power. The 15x multiple is ~20% below the stock's one-year average and reflects the CEO transition.
Citi's forecasts imply revenue growth of 90.5% in FY27E, 69.9% in FY28E and 34.6% in FY29E, with gross margin of 73.6% in FY27E.

market_movers.rationale: Target cut to $225 from $285 on a 20% multiple discount for CEO-transition uncertainty. Buy kept because the stock trades at ~11x P/E, in line with its prior trough.

earnings_insights: Citi core EPS FY27E (Jan-27 year) $9.26E, unchanged from its prior estimate, vs First Call consensus $9.30 and Visible Alpha consensus $9.36. Quarterly: Q1 $1.87A, Q2 $2.22A, Q3 $2.44E, Q4 $2.74E.
Citi core EPS FY28E $15.17E, unchanged, vs First Call consensus $15.84 and Visible Alpha $15.96. FY29E $19.98E vs First Call and Visible Alpha consensus of $20.99.
Citi FY26A core EPS was $4.49 (reported EPS $4.90), vs consensus of $4.77. Citi FY27E revenue is $411.4B (+90.5%), and FY28E revenue is $699.1B (+69.9%).
risk_factors: Leadership transition risk: a forced Huang departure would create an overhang given his central role in strategy, product vision, customer relationships and investor confidence.
Governance and investigation risk: the board is reported to be discussing Huang's future following the allegations.
Citi's listed downside risks to the target: gaming competition and share loss, slower adoption of new platforms, lumpiness in auto and data center markets, and cryptomining impact on gaming sales.
geopolitical: The report refers to scrutiny from a prior reported relationship involving a suspected Chinese intelligence asset.
